items.title: Unit 12 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Rice, meat and carrots for Billy. Do you like carrots, Billy? No, I don't. No carrots for me!

What do you like, Billy? Do you like yogurt? Yes, I do! OK. First your carrots and then a yogurt.

Finished! Good boy. Here's your yogurt. Mmm. I like yogurt.

Oh no!
